a.quote: ➖Pair - лаунчпад на хуках Uniswap v4. Здесь токен можно запускать не только в паре с ETH или стейблом, а сразу привязывать к корзине активов, включая токенизированные акции.

qualifiers.feature: can launch token in pair with ETH or stablecoin or basket

b.quote: The protocol routes ETH fees into vaults, protocol-owned liquidity and the team, and pairs STANDARD against ETH in a hooked Uniswap v4 pool. Access runs through Charters: only 1,000 Genesis Charters exist, minted free to the allowlist at launch, with further Charters and expansion licenses sold later through daily ETH Dutch auctions. Launch day is timed: the allowlist mint at 5:30 PM EST, a public Dutch auction at 8:30, then liquidity and Charter emissions from 9:00 PM. Post-mint trading opens with an anti-snipe tax that starts at 90% and decays on a five-minute half-life back to normal fees.
